description: Add a text or Markdown document to a knowledge collection (plan limits apply). It is chunked by structure, given chunk context, embedded and searchable within a minute. Optional language (fi/en/sv), tags and chunking. Confirm to apply. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

chunkOverlap.description: Characters carried over between chunks of one section

chunkStrategy.description: auto = structure-aware (headings, tables, FAQ, CSV rows)

contextual.description: Write a 1-2 sentence context for every chunk at ingest

mode.description: rag = searched per question, cag = always in the agent prompt

textWeight.description: Fusion weight of full text search (0-5)

name: oma_crew_knowledge_source_create
title: Add knowledge document
